context: Two cafe friends share marriage and partner stories
purpose: Teach: じつは/御存じ/わたくし/イマイチ/少なから/すぐれ/等しい/だんな

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ねえ、じつは最近うちのだんなのことで、ちょっと相談していい？
lines.en: Hey, actually I've been having issues with my husband lately. Can I talk to you about it?
lines.style: Soft confessional tone, slightly hesitant but warm and intimate between close friends.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もちろん。あおいさんも長い付き合いだし、なんでも聞くよ。
lines.en: Of course. We've known each other a long time, so tell me anything.
lines.style: Calm reassuring barista voice, gentle and inviting with practiced empathy in casual speech.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近ね、会話がほとんどなくて、なんか気持ちもゼロに等しい感じなの。
lines.en: Lately we barely talk at all, and honestly my feelings feel close to zero.
lines.style: Vulnerable and quiet, voice trailing off with genuine sadness and uncertainty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あー、わかる。うちも最初の数年は体調もすぐれない時期があってさ、けっこうしんどかった。
lines.en: Ah, I get it. In our first few years my health wasn't great either, and it was pretty rough.
lines.style: Wise older-sister tone, measured pacing with reflective warmth and gentle authority.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼はいい人だと思うんだけど、最近すれ違いばっかりで気分もイマイチで。
lines.en: He's a good person, I think, but lately we keep missing each other and my mood's just off.
lines.style: Wistful and apologetic, defending him while admitting the painful distance between them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 御存じかもしれないけど、わたくしも一度は離婚を考えたことあるんだよ、本当に。
lines.en: You might know this already, but I once even considered divorce, truly.
lines.style: Soft but firm delivery, sharing a hard-won confession over coffee steam with a wry half-smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、そうだったの？少なからずショック…でも、なんかちょっと安心したかも。
lines.en: Wait, really? That's quite a shock... but somehow it kind of makes me feel better.
lines.style: Surprised then softened, voice lifting with relief and gentle laughter under the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 時間かけて、少しずつ話す習慣を戻したんだ。めいちゃんたちも、きっと大丈夫だよ。
lines.en: We took time and slowly rebuilt the habit of talking. You two will be fine too, I'm sure.
lines.style: Quiet confident encouragement, sharing personal history to comfort a struggling friend.
